title: Dominic and the Hymn
author: Emrys Eastwick
blurb: Bram Kavanagh, the new teacher at a school with a missing-class problem, keeps the lights on and the doors counted. Then the childhood imaginary friend is waiting on the porch, unchanged — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must learn the song's last verse without singing along, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
